shared_elements: low-relief carving on weathered grey stone
incised curvilinear lines on a rounded stone mass
justification: Both are weathered grey stone surfaces bearing shallow relief with anthropomorphic figures whose arms are bent and raised, and in each case the carving follows the swelling curvature of the block rather than a flat plane. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a single monumental, frontal, vertical figure with abstract geometric additions (concentric disc, banded chevrons), while B is a horizontal frieze of several small, squat, actively posed figures in a narrative row, rendered in a rounder, more modelled manner.
